standard.summary: SDXL 专用的 block-level CPU offload 实现，将部分 UNet block 卸载到 CPU 内存以节省 VRAM。
standard.effect: 可以在 8GB 显卡上训练 SDXL LoRA（正常需要 12~16GB）。input_blocks / output_blocks / middle_block 分别控制哪些层被 offload。
standard.whenToUse: 8~12GB 显卡训练 SDXL 时的必选项。结合 gradient_checkpointing 和 xformers 使用。
standard.avoidWhen: 显存充足（>16GB）时不需要，会降低训练速度（PCIe 传输开销）。

standard_en.summary: The SDXL-specific block-level CPU offload implementation, which moves some UNet blocks out to CPU memory to save VRAM.
standard_en.effect: It makes SDXL LoRA training possible on an 8GB card (normally 12~16GB is needed). input_blocks / output_blocks / middle_block each control which layers get offloaded.
standard_en.whenToUse: A must on an 8~12GB card when training SDXL. Use it together with gradient_checkpointing and xformers.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Not needed when VRAM is plentiful (>16GB); it slows training down (the PCIe transfer overhead).

advanced.principle: SDXL UNet 有 input_blocks（下采样）、middle_block（瓶颈）、output_blocks（上采样）三组，各组可独立 offload。offload_after_backward 在 backward 完成后立即卸载（而非 step 结束），最大化 VRAM 节省。
advanced.tradeoffs: SDXL block swap 实现是 SDXL 专用的，与 Anima 的 anima_block_prefetch 是不同的实现。sequential_cpu_offload 是最激进的（逐层 offload），最省 VRAM 但最慢。

advanced_en.principle: The SDXL UNet has three groups — input_blocks (downsampling), middle_block (bottleneck), output_blocks (upsampling) — and each group can be offloaded independently. offload_after_backward unloads immediately after backward completes (not at step end), maximizing VRAM savings.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The SDXL block swap implementation is SDXL-specific and distinct from Anima's anima_block_prefetch. sequential_cpu_offload is the most aggressive (layer-by-layer offload): most VRAM savings but slowest.
